title: Gift to Memory linkage contract tests
description: Guarantee successful gifts always create or attach a memory entry. Acceptance: Contract test passes for gift success path; no new Gifts Missing Memory in 7-day diagnostics.

title: Memory Book media rendering hardening
description: Ensure text, image, and video entries render predictably on web and mobile. Acceptance: No media rendering crashes; fallback states shown for invalid media URLs.

title: Thank-you workflow status model
description: Implement explicit thank-you lifecycle states and retry handling. Acceptance: Status visible in UI and admin diagnostics; failed sends are retryable.

title: Gift success page data accuracy pass
description: Ensure confirmation reflects real amount and execution model. Acceptance: No $0 confirmations for paid gifts; stock-pick gifts show chosen ticker where applicable.

title: Memory Book cross-linking from gifts
description: Add direct navigation from gift rows to related memory entries. Acceptance: Gift row includes View memory when linked; link opens correct memory entry.

title: Thank-you CTA placement optimization
description: Improve thank-you completion by better CTA positioning. Acceptance: CTA present in memory and gift detail contexts; thank-you action rate improves from Week 2 baseline.

title: Admin diagnostics for thank-you gaps
description: Surface missing thank-you records with drill-down and export. Acceptance: Metric links to affected gifts; drill-down supports CSV export.

title: Week 3 loop scorecard
description: Publish weekly loop health report for memory and thank-you completion. Acceptance: Weekly report includes trend and deltas; shared in Friday cadence.
